title: Golden Kitty: The Robinhood Chain Token Priced in Gold
description:
In 2015, Robinhood won a trophy called the Golden Kitty. The Product Hunt community voted it the Sexiest Product of the Year. That trophy is now a token on Robinhood's own blockchain, Golden Kitty ($GOLDEN), and it's priced in gold.

Most meme coins trade against Ethereum or a stablecoin. This one trades against GLD, Robinhood's tokenized version of the SPDR Gold Trust. So I break down what paired to gold actually means, why that makes Golden Kitty priced in gold, and why it is still a meme coin that you can't redeem for gold.

Then I get into the stonk narrative forming on the Robinhood chain: meme coins paired to tokenized stocks, commodities and blue chip crypto. And I make the case for why a gold paired token on Robinhood's own chain is sitting in a prime spot while Robinhood's own customers have barely shown up yet.
